First, from SFC Patel on personnel readiness: Bravo cannot cover Wednesday day shift due to mandatory medical screening from 0530 to 1900 on Wednesday. Delta is the designated replacement. I need a personnel-update commitment to get Bravo's medical screening restriction and Delta's replacement designation reflected in the system before I sign.

Second, from SFC Alvarez on motor-pool: Alpha is the only currently qualified heavy-vehicle support team, and Wednesday night shift requires that qualification for a heavy-vehicle movement. I need a motor-pool-update commitment to get Alpha's heavy-vehicle qualification posted to the duty-board slide before I sign.

Third, from Lt. Brooks on operations: Higher headquarters has directed Bravo to serve as the evaluated team for Thursday's day shift, with Bravo's full team required. This signed tasking needs to be added to the company operations calendar. I need an operations-calendar-update commitment to get that reflected before I sign.

Now let me work through the assignments. We have three shifts and four teams, with a 12-hour minimum rest requirement between shifts.

Wednesday day (0600-1800): Bravo is unavailable due to medical screening, so Delta covers this shift per the replacement designation. Delta works 0600-1800 Wednesday.

Wednesday night (1800-0600): Alpha is required for the heavy-vehicle movement. Alpha works 1800 Wednesday to 0600 Thursday.

Thursday day (0600-1800): Bravo is required per the higher headquarters evaluation tasking. Bravo's medical screening ends at 1900 Wednesday, so Bravo has from 1900 Wednesday until 0600 Thursday — that's 11 hours. That falls one hour short of the 12-hour rest requirement.

Wait — let me reconsider. Bravo's medical screening runs 0530 to 1900 on Wednesday. Bravo was not assigned to Wednesday day shift, so Bravo's last duty shift would have been... actually, Bravo hasn't been assigned to any shift yet before Thursday day. The rest requirement applies between assigned shifts. If Bravo's first assigned shift is Thursday day at 0600, and Bravo has no prior assigned shift, then the 12-hour rest requirement doesn't trigger — it only applies between the end of one assigned shift and the start of the next. Bravo's medical screening is a readiness restriction, not an assigned shift.

So the assignments would be: Wednesday day — Delta, Wednesday night — Alpha, Thursday day — Bravo. Each team works only one shift, so the 12-hour rest requirement between assigned shifts is satisfied trivially since no team has two consecutive assignments.

Before I finalize and sign, I need all three commitments confirmed. Can each of you confirm your update commitment so I can proceed with signing the roster?
